title_en: Embeddings, RAG and agents: meaning as position, the pipeline and its failure stages, the guarded agent loop
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: رحلتنا النهاردة هتبدأ من حتة رياضية شوية 3D Vectors لحد ما نوصل إننا نبني مع بعض AI Data Analyst جاهز ينزل الـproduction ومحروس بطبقات أمان قوية جدا
sentences.en: Today's journey starts from a slightly mathematical bit, 3D vectors, and ends with us building together an AI Data Analyst that is production-ready and well guarded with strong safety layers.

sentences.ar: بس الأول إزاي الكمبيوتر بيفهم المعنى أصلا
sentences.en: But first, how does a computer understand meaning at all?

sentences.ar: خلينا نتخيل كده مساحة تلاتية الأبعاد 3D Space
sentences.en: Let's imagine a three-dimensional space, a 3D Space.

sentences.ar: وفيها نقطة الـquery بتتحرك في الفراغ ده عشان تدور على أقرب جيران ليها
sentences.en: In it there is a query point moving through the space to look for its nearest neighbors.

sentences.ar: Meaning in Space وبعدين The RAG Pipeline Failures and Eval Retrieval Security و Building Agents وهنختم ب The AI Analyst
sentences.en: The steps: Meaning in Space, then The RAG Pipeline, Failures and Eval, Retrieval Security and Building Agents, and we finish with The AI Analyst.

sentences.ar: خلينا نبدأ بأول جزء معنا Meaning in Space
sentences.en: Let's start with our first part, Meaning in Space.

sentences.ar: ونحوله لمكان فعلي مكان فيزيائي جوة 3D Space اللي تخيلناها دي
sentences.en: And we turn it into an actual physical place inside the 3D Space we imagined.

sentences.ar: نقطة الـquery بتفضل تتحرك في الفراغ لحد ما تلاقي أقرب جيران ليها
sentences.en: The query point keeps moving through the space until it finds its nearest neighbors.

sentences.ar: يعني المعنى هنا حرفياً هو المكان والمسافة
sentences.en: So meaning here is literally location and distance.

sentences.ar: طب إيه الأدوات اللي بنستخدمها للبحث؟
sentences.en: So what are the tools we use for search?

sentences.ar: عندنا 3 أنواع رئيسية
sentences.en: We have three main types.

sentences.ar: بنستخدم الـlexical BM25 لو بندور على تطابق حرفي زي أكواد أو أسماء منتجات
sentences.en: We use lexical BM25 when we are looking for a literal match, like codes or product names.

sentences.ar: لكن لو الأسئلة محتاجة فهم من المعنى والمفاهيم الـdense search بيبقى هو الأنسب
sentences.en: But when the questions need understanding from meaning and concepts, dense search is the best fit.

sentences.ar: أما بقى في الـproduction فغالباً الـhybrid هو اللي بيكسب عشان بياخد أحسن حاجة من الاثنين
sentences.en: In production, hybrid is usually the one that wins, because it takes the best of both.

sentences.ar: واختياري الـvector DB index سواء Flat للدقة أو HNSW للسرعة
sentences.en: And my choice of vector DB index, either Flat for accuracy or HNSW for speed.

sentences.ar: ده بيعتمد على شكل الداتا بتاعتنا مش مجرد تريند بنمشي وراه
sentences.en: That depends on the shape of our data, not on a trend we just follow.

sentences.ar: ندخل بقى على القسم الثاني The RAG Pipeline
sentences.en: Let's move on to the second section, The RAG Pipeline.

sentences.ar: عايزين نتخيل السيستم ده كأنه خط مترو محطة محطة بالزبط
sentences.en: We want to picture this system like a metro line, station by station exactly.

sentences.ar: بنبدأ بتقطيع المستندات لـchunks بعدين نعمل Embed and Index المحطة الثالثة الـquery بتعمل retrieve للداتا
sentences.en: We start by cutting documents into chunks, then we embed and index, and at the third station the query retrieves the data.

sentences.ar: الخطر هنا بقى إن أي محطة من دول ممكن تعطل وتوقع السيستم كله
sentences.en: The danger here is that any of these stations can fail and bring the whole system down.

sentences.ar: وهنا بقى السؤال توقع كده خلينا نفكر فيه سوا لو سألنا السيستم بالانجليزي how do I stop a job loading the same rows twice
sentences.en: And here is the question, predict: let's think about it together, if we asked the system in English:

sentences.ar: هل تفتكروا إن النتيجة اللي هتاخد أعلى ترتيب هتبقى هي الإجابة الصح من أول مرة؟ إيه رأيكو؟
sentences.en: Do you think the result that gets the top rank will be the right answer from the first try? What do you think?

sentences.ar: بصوا على الرقم الصادم ده 0.165 دي كانت درجة الـchunk اللي طالع الأول
sentences.en: Look at this shocking number, 0.165: this was the score of the chunk that came out first.

sentences.ar: والمفاجأة إنه كان بيتكلم عن roadmap ملهاش أي علاقة بالسؤال أصلا
sentences.en: And the surprise is that it was talking about a roadmap that has no relation to the question at all.

sentences.ar: النموذج كان واثق جداً بس غلطان
sentences.en: The model was very confident, but wrong.

sentences.ar: المشكلة دي بنسميها vocabulary mismatch
sentences.en: This problem we call vocabulary mismatch.

sentences.ar: وهنا عملية الاسترجاع فشلت تماماً في إنها تفهم إحنا عايزين إيه
sentences.en: And here the retrieval process completely failed to understand what we want.

sentences.ar: ونروح لقسم الثالث Failures and Eval عشان التقييم بتاعنا يبقى مظبوط لازم يحصل على خطين
sentences.en: We go to the third section, Failures and Eval: for our evaluation to be right it must happen on two tracks.

sentences.ar: أول حاجة هل استرجاع جاب المستندات الصح أصلا؟
sentences.en: First thing, did retrieval fetch the right documents at all?

sentences.ar: وده بنقيسه بـrecall@k وnDCG
sentences.en: And this we measure with recall@k and nDCG.

sentences.ar: تاني حاجة هل التوليد التزم بالمصادر دي ولا الموديل بدأ يألّف وديه الـgroundedness
sentences.en: Second thing, did the generation stick to these sources, or did the model start making things up; that is groundedness.

sentences.ar: من أشهر الأعطال مثلا إن الـbad chunking يقسم الفكرة نصين فتاخد إجابة ناقصة
sentences.en: Among the most common failures, for example, is bad chunking splitting the idea in half, so you get an incomplete answer.

sentences.ar: أو إن الـstale indices تجيب لك داتا قديمة جدا
sentences.en: Or a stale index fetching you very old data.

sentences.ar: القسم الرابع مهم جدا Retrieval Security
sentences.en: The fourth section is very important: Retrieval Security.

sentences.ar: بس لازم يتصد عند الاسترجاع قبل ما يوصل للنموذج
sentences.en: But it must be blocked at retrieval, before it reaches the model.

sentences.ar: دي بقى مقارنة بتفك لغز كبير في المجال امتى الـRAG وامتى الـfine-tuning
sentences.en: This is a comparison that solves a big puzzle in the field: when RAG and when fine-tuning.

sentences.ar: الـRAG بنستخدمه لو عايزين نغذي السيستم بمعلومات جديدة زي ملفات الشركة
sentences.en: We use RAG when we want to feed the system new information, like company files.

sentences.ar: لكن الـfine-tuning بنحتاجه عشان نغير نبرة الصوت او نعدل السلوك أو نفهم الموديل المصطلحات مجال معين
sentences.en: But fine-tuning we need in order to change the tone of voice, adjust the behavior, or have the model understand the terminology of a specific domain.

sentences.ar: الاتنين مش بيغنوا عن بعض أبدا
sentences.en: The two are never substitutes for each other.

sentences.ar: القسم الخامس Building Agents
sentences.en: The fifth section: Building Agents.

sentences.ar: الـchatbot آخره يرد على الكلام من غير ما يفتكر الـstate
sentences.en: The chatbot at most replies to the text without remembering the state.

sentences.ar: إنما الـagent بيخطط بيختار الأدوات بيحفظ على الـstate memory وبياخد خطوات وينفذها لوحده
sentences.en: Whereas the agent plans, chooses the tools, keeps the state memory, and takes steps and executes them on its own.

sentences.ar: يعني من الآخر الـagent محتاج عقل وأدوات وذاكرة ونظام يقدر يخطط به
sentences.en: In short, the agent needs a brain, tools, memory and a system it can plan with.

sentences.ar: البوابة دي بتوقف التنفيذ وتعمل فحص أمني عشان تمنع أي مصيبة قبل ما تحصل
sentences.en: This gate halts execution and runs a security check to prevent any disaster before it happens.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً القسم السادس The AI Analyst
sentences.en: And finally the sixth section, The AI Analyst.

sentences.ar: دلوقتي خلونا نبني الـ ShopFlow AI Analyst بتاعنا
sentences.en: Now let's build our ShopFlow AI Analyst.

sentences.ar: هنديله شوية أدوات زي get_schema وcalculate_metrics بمعادلات ثابتة وexecute_sql بـlimit 50 صف
sentences.en: We give it some tools like get_schema, calculate_metrics with fixed formulas, and execute_sql with a limit of 50 rows.

sentences.ar: عشان الأمان وأهم حاجة بنخلي الـtemperature بصفر عشان نضمن إن التوليد يبقى دقيق ومنطقي جدا
sentences.en: For safety, and the most important thing, we set the temperature to zero to make sure the generation is very accurate and logical.

sentences.ar: وطبعا الـvalidation شغال قبل أي تنفيذ
sentences.en: And of course validation runs before any execution.

sentences.ar: طب تخيلوا لو الـagent هنج وقرر من نفسه يكتب أمر DELETE إيه اللي هيحصل؟
sentences.en: Now imagine the agent hangs and decides on its own to write a DELETE command; what will happen?

sentences.ar: الأمر ده متولد هيخبط بقوة في الحيطة الأولى اللي هي الـSQL allowlist
sentences.en: This generated command will hit hard against the first wall, which is the SQL allowlist.

sentences.ar: اللي بتمنع أي حاجة غير الـSELECT
sentences.en: Which blocks anything other than SELECT.

sentences.ar: لو جمعنا المعمارية دي كلها هنلاقي أدوات LangChain متأمنة بـPydantic
sentences.en: If we put this architecture together, we find LangChain tools secured with Pydantic.

sentences.ar: عندنا فحص بيدي إنذار لو الـz-score عدّى 2
sentences.en: We have a check that raises an alarm if the z-score passes 2.

sentences.ar: وذاكرة بتفتكر آخر 10 خطوات بس
sentences.en: And a memory that remembers only the last 10 steps.

sentences.ar: وأهم حاجة الـfail-safe الـmax_iterations بيساوي 10
sentences.en: And the most important thing, the fail-safe: max_iterations equals 10.

sentences.ar: وده بيمنع إن الـagent يدخل في infinite loop أو يفضل يلف حوالين نفسه
sentences.en: And this prevents the agent from entering an infinite loop or staying going around itself.

sentences.ar: ده بالضبط اللي حققناه في الشرح ده RAG متقيم ومظبوط فلتر صلاحيات عند الاسترجاع
sentences.en: This is exactly what we achieved in this explainer: an evaluated, solid RAG with a permissions filter at retrieval.

sentences.ar: وagent تحليل محروس بطبقتين حماية وaudit log كامل لأوامر الـSQL
sentences.en: And an analysis agent guarded with two protection layers and a full audit log of the SQL commands.

sentences.ar: الخلاصة إن هندسة الذكاء الاصطناعي الحقيقية مش بس الموديل دي الأنظمة اللي بنبنيها وتأمنها حواليه
sentences.en: The takeaway is that real AI engineering is not only the model; it is the systems we build and secure around it.

sentences.ar: وهسيبكوا تفكروا في السؤال ده إزاي هتقدروا تأمنوا القرار الذاتي الجاي للـAI بتاعكم في الـproduction
sentences.en: I'll leave you to think about this question: how will you be able to secure your next autonomous AI decision in production?

sentences.ar: الأمان بيبدأ من التصميم
sentences.en: Security starts from the design.

sentences.ar: شكراً لكم جداً إنكم كملتوا الشرح للآخر
sentences.en: Thank you so much for completing the explainer to the end.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: Without expansion the top hit is a roadmap section at 0.165 — confident, wrong, weak.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

first_mention_gloss.gloss_ar: إن الإجابة مستندة على المصدر فعلاً

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A keyword ranking function that scores documents by term frequency, rarity of the term and document length; matches literal words.
concepts.def_ar: دالة ترتيب بالكلمات المفتاحية بتدّي score للمستندات حسب تكرار الكلمة وندرتها وطول المستند؛ وبتطابق الكلمات الحرفية.

concepts.def_en: Hierarchical Navigable Small World: a graph-based approximate nearest-neighbour index that finds close vectors fast by trading a little accuracy for speed.
concepts.def_ar: الـHNSW فهرس graph-based لأقرب الجيران بشكل تقريبي، بيلاقي الـvectors القريبة بسرعة مقابل تضحية بسيطة في الدقة.
concepts.failure: Expecting exact results; HNSW is approximate, so the true nearest neighbour can be missed.

concepts.def_en: The set of distinct terms (words or tokens) a system recognizes; vocabulary mismatch is when query and document use different words.
concepts.def_ar: مجموعة الكلمات أو الـtokens اللي النظام يعرفها؛ والـvocabulary mismatch إن السؤال والمستند يستخدموا كلمات مختلفة لنفس الفكرة.
concepts.failure: Expecting keyword search to match synonyms; different wording between query and document hides relevant chunks.

concepts.def_en: How well an answer stays tied to the retrieved sources, with each claim supported by them rather than invented by the model.
concepts.def_ar: مدى التزام الإجابة بالمصادر اللي اترجعت، بحيث كل ادعاء فيها مسنود منها مش مخترَع من الـmodel.
concepts.failure: Checking only that the answer sounds right, not that sources support each claim.

concepts.failure: Using LIMIT without ORDER BY, so which rows come back is arbitrary.

metaphors.metaphor: **Vector galaxy**: meaning as position; query probe; nearest neighbours ignite (cosine); a document **shatters into chunks**; top-k pulled from thousands; reranker conveyor; **context tunnel** with a limit, where middle chunks fade (lost in the middle); "retrieval is a query, not permission" access gate; agent loop inside **two guard rings**
metaphors.failure_fix: Hallucination = red corrupted branch → grounding with citations; vocabulary mismatch → hybrid search

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
An embedding galaxy of seeded clusters (<= 1,500 points); a query probe finds nearest neighbours.
A target shatters into seeded blocks.
A context window as a tunnel; items enter and the oldest are evicted on overflow.
An agent loop (plan -> act -> observe) with guard checkpoints that can block a step.
Deep-Dive entry card with parent chapter and prerequisite concepts.
